audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted the mirror (karma__maokai) and its own whys at rows 4 and 5. Row 4 (Level 6) read Karma even though whys[4] says her Mantra 'barely moves the 1v1'; row 5 (First item) read Maokai even though whys[5] says 'even, since she out-pokes but you out-last'. The mirror already set row 4 to Maokai (3/10 from her side) and row 5 to Skill (5/10).
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1 and costs no skill point (Riot text), so level 6 is not a Karma spike — it is Maokai's, since Nature's Grasp arrives there. Her first AP item plus Inspire move speed genuinely evens the first-item stage.
audit.corrected: Row 4 -> Maokai 7/10, row 5 -> Skill 5/10, proposed as paired full+content edits so both layers move together.
sources: brief kit text (Karma R: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point')

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike language was vague ('the moment his answer is down') with no numbers, and Level 6 was framed as Karma's spike.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank and Mantra is 40/38/36/34s reduced by her damaging abilities; Maokai's W is 14/13/12/11/10s and R is 130/110/90s. Those are the numbers that make 'wait then commit' concrete.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into tldr, winCon, phases[4].why, phases[5].why and the interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated. Pages said Focused Resolve 'breaks if you LoS / outrange it' but never noted that Maokai's Twisted Advance dashes TOWARD her, which shortens the tether and therefore can never break it.
audit.why: Riot text: the tether roots the target unless it is broken; breaking is a distance/LoS condition. Maokai's only gap-closer moves him to her, so engaging into an active tether guarantees the root lands.
audit.corrected: Stated in winCon and report[5].t: bait or wait out the 12s, do not try to dash out of the tether.

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma referred to as 'him'/'his' throughout the full layer.
audit.why: Karma is female; the content layer already uses 'her'. Mixed pronouns read as unedited boilerplate.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the edited strings.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Nature’s Grasp roots her at 130s cooldown — spend it on a kill window. Mantra existed since level 1, so 6 is your spike, not hers.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Even: her AP item and Inspire speed kite your W, but Heartsteel out-lasts it. Fight on her 12s root.

edits.before: Weather the poke — root him on the Focused Resolve cooldown and grind him with saplings. Maokai wins the Focused Resolve cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank, so W-root her in that window and grind her down with saplings and Sap Magic.

edits.before: Root him on the Focused Resolve cooldown and grind him with saplings. Track Focused Resolve before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Root her when Focused Resolve is down — 12s flat at all ranks. Never break the tether by dashing in: W closes range, so bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Karma wins by landing Focused Resolve, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Karma wins by landing Focused Resolve at 675 range, then kiting off Inspire speed while Q pokes.

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her tether roots after a delay unless you outrange it — 675 range, 12s. Engage when it is down.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — W-root + sapling chain.
edits.after: Focused Resolve tethers at 675 and only breaks on distance — your W dashes toward her, so it never breaks it. Engage on its 12s.

edits.before: That is Karma's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Karma's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.

edits.before: If Karma gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Focused Resolve. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If he snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.
edits.after: If Karma gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Focused Resolve. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

notes:
Kit-flag defect: Maokai's Q carries a 'grounding' flag in _kits/maokai.json, but Riot's own description is knockback + magic damage + slow with no grounding. Per instructions I trusted the description and wrote no grounding claim anywhere. Worth fixing at source since a grounding claim vs dash champions would be a shipped falsehood.

Diff/diffRating left at TRICKY 7.5/10 despite a 49.54% win rate over 218 games, which reads closer to EVEN. That is a champion-level difficulty call, not a mechanical one — flagged in questionsForUser rather than flipped unilaterally.
